en.description:
Bubble Wars – Played by over 10 million users across the world, is an epic bubble shooter game featuring amazing bubble busting levels and addictive gameplay with serious bubble shooting and popping fun. Get on a war with the colorful world of bubbles, literally. What’s more? This bubble shooting game is completely FREE! 

Make a combination of 3 or more bubbles with same color to make them explode! To make it more exciting, the entire army of bubbles sits on a spinning ring full of bubbles. Each time you shoot the bubbles, the bubble ring spins, thus changing the dynamics of your strategy in real time. Challenge your hunger and test your skills to shoot, pop and defeat the army of bubbles in Bubble Wars..

## Challenging Game Modes ##

Attack mode: Shoot colored bubbles at the bubble spinner circle and try to shrink it. If you get 3 or more colors in a row the bubbles burst and are destroyed. Otherwise the circle can grow again. Once it is large enough to hit you, the game ends.

Defend modes: Shoot colored bubbles at a bubble spinning ring that surrounds you. If you get 3 or more colors in a row the bubbles burst are destroyed. Otherwise the ring can start shrinking around you. Once it reaches you, the game ends.

## Awesome Features ##

-- Exciting Gameplay
-- Exploding Bubbles – Just Point and Shoot 
-- Multiple Bubble Combinations
-- High Scores to keep a tab and challenge yourself. 
-- Fast Paced Arcade Game
-- Accurate and Simple controls
-- Continuous updates 
-- And much much more...

Original and widely played bubble shooter arcade game is back with serious fun and shooting challenges of course.  

Thanks for playing Bubble Wars and we would love to hear back from you!
en.releaseNotes: This version includes a number of minor bug fixes. It also changes the game over scene of the game by showing the last ball shot and the game centers so it is easier to see why a game ended.  Thank you for playing Bubble Wars!
en.subtitle: Attack and Defend with Bubbles

versionHistory.releaseNotes: This version of Bubble Wars includes significant improvements to every aspect of the game.  It also switches the app to Metal to improve GPU and battery performance.

Version 11.0 brought significant improvements to every aspect of the game and switched the game to Metal.  This update makes a number of tweaks to the game including some adjustment to screen layout, fixing a delay that sometimes occurred when shots were fired, and improves the movement of incoming bubbles.

Please note the new background animation and the color mark feature can both be configured using the settings button on main screen of the app.

It was possible for Bubble Wars to get confused and start in TV mode if device was in landscape orientation and device Rotation Lock setting was off.  It has been changed to prevent this.  Apologies to all impacted by that bug; future landscape supported will be looked into.

Note: Games already in progress in the bad orientation may initially display incorrectly after this update but will self correct on next Play button push.

This update to Bubble Wars corrects an issue with incoming bubbles, improves text rendering and positioning in the app, and adds languages from the top countries where Bubble Wars is most popular.  Thank you for playing Bubble Wars!

Bubble Wars has been updated with two changes to improve game play:
 
In Defend mode, the collision detection with the play has been improved and game ends based on a bubble landing right next to the shooter vs distance.  So it is more consistent and predictable.  It is also easier to see why a game ended.

In all modes, the shot collision detection has been improved by about 16x, resulting in better shot landing.  (This improvement is for player's shot only)

Thank you for playing Bubble Wars!
Corrected point/level information for some of the languages.

This update includes:

- Apple Watch version of Bubble Wars.
- Fix for a green screen issue on phoneOS devices 

Please note that the Apple Watch version of the game has a different difficulty level (it scales up in difficulty faster like older versions of Bubble Wars) and will not progress between itself and the phoneOS version.

Thank you for playing Bubble Wars!

This update includes:

- A fix in the in the mathematics engine which sometimes caused moving bubbles to calculate or place incorrectly.
- Removal of the coloring penalty for bubbles thrown away (when shooting at empty space).
- Corrects rotation direction in Attack mode.

Thanks for playing Bubble Wars.

This version of Bubble Wars is about improving leveling.  It combines the Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels, letting you switch the same game between them as desired while maintaining progress.  It also adds a seconds medium difficulty, Medium 1, which mimics the pre-2016 game difficulty.  Additionally, it balances the number of bubbles landing during the penalty phase.  

Thanks for playing Bubble Wars!
This version fixes a bug where bubble color could change when penalty bubbles were added.  It also fixes a left-over bubble bug on Apple Watch version of the game.
This version fixes a bug where bubble color could change when penalty bubbles were added.
This version fixes a bug where trying to Backup or Restore would exit the app if internet was not available.
This version removes sound from Apple Watch version of the game.
This version removes sound from Apple Watch version of the game as well and improves Apple Watch resource usage.
This version includes minor bug fixes.
This version includes minor bug fixes.
This version includes minor bug fixes.
This version includes various minor internal fixes.
This version fixes an internal issue related to transfer of game progress.

This new version includes changes to comply with latest EU regulations, corrects the language code for Indonesian from IN to ID, expands the languages supported by the game by adding Turkish, and on Apple Watch adjusts the push-in animation to be consistent between different screen sizes.  Thank you for playing Bubble Wars!
This version fixes a user-reported crash that was occurring on Apple Watches.
This version makes additional changes to Apple Watch versions of the game so corrupted game saves do not crash the game.

phoneOS/padOS:

This version of Bubble Wars re-enables Game Center leaderboards that were disabled many years ago, and switches progress from score to level. If you already have progress before this reset it is maintained within the app and will be uploaded to the new leaderboards soon. Older leaderboards will be maintained for a short while and then removed.

Apple Watch:

Progress is now kept when game ends.
Ball bounces in Attack mode have small improvements to them.

Thanks for playing Bubble Wars!
This update includes various minor internal improvements.  Thank you for playing Bubble Wars!
